# Hritikpedia

> Stop Searching. Start Learning. The Definitive Computer Science & Engineering Study Library.

Hritikpedia is an open-access educational notes and examination preparation platform engineered for university engineering students (B.Tech, BCA, MCA) and competitive examination candidates (Bihar STET Computer Science Paper-II, BPSC Computer Teacher TRE 3.0/4.0, GATE CSE).

## Core Academic Offerings
- **Study Notes & Exam Blueprints:** High-yield chapter summaries, relational database normalization proofs (1NF to BCNF), operating system semaphore concurrency primitives, deadlock handling algorithms, network subnetting tables, and digital logic Karnaugh maps.
- **Evaluative Mock Tests:** Interactive, timed examinations simulating official examination environments with instant score analytics, accuracy percentages, and step-by-step verified answer explanations.
- **Open-Access Free Revision Shelf:** 100% free downloadable formula cheat sheets, SQL syntaxes, truth tables, and networking protocol stacks.
- **Editorial Study Guides:** Deep-dive conceptual roadmaps and syllabus-mapping strategies written by verified academic mentors.

## Key Sections & Canonical Links
- [All Study Notes](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/notes): Browse complete curriculum-mapped notes by domain and exam.
- [Computer Science Subjects](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/subjects): Subject directory covering DBMS, Operating Systems, Computer Networks, Digital Logic, and Algorithms.
- [Evaluative Mock Tests](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/tests): Practice timed examination papers for Bihar STET and BPSC Teacher.
- [Free Revision Handbooks](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/free-resources): Zero-cost formula blueprints and reference sheets.
- [Educational Guides & Strategy](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/articles): Technical articles on database normalization, concurrency, and exam blueprints.
- [About & Editorial Standards](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/about): Mission, authentic data policy, zero-budget-first model, and educator credentials.
- [Student Support & Helpdesk](https://hritikpedia.vercel.app/contact): Official support desk and student assistance.

## Standards & Integrity
- All materials are mapped strictly against official syllabus notifications (BSEB, BPSC, AKTU, BEU).
- Zero fabricated testimonials; verified mathematical proofs with zero skipped steps.
- Clean distraction-free in-browser reading with dynamic security watermarking.
